title: WOWFLUTTER
description: Every record is an issue. An independent label's site built as a magazine you turn by hand: drag a page corner and the leaf lifts on a real hinge.
stack: Next.js 16 · Tailwind v4 · CSS 3D Page-Turn · Pointer Events

sections.title: Cover (stock)
sections.summary: mono row "Issue 07 · Autumn 2026" / "WF-007"; a giant "07" in Young Serif with a pink off-register copy behind it; the **only h1**, "The Sound of Rooms"; a plate (`cover-portrait`, priority/LCP); the mark and "32 pages · Edition of 500".

sections.title: Editor's letter (worn)
sections.summary: "A note on rooms", two short paragraphs with a pink drop cap, the signature "Dee Okafor-Lind, editor", a masthead (Editor, Design, Print, Stitching).

sections.title: Contents (stock)
sections.summary: five rows, each a link: page number on a pink square, title, italic note. Stairwell sessions 04, The roster 07, The catalogue 10, The pressing plant 12, Get the next issue 13.

sections.title: Feature opener (a black page)
sections.summary: a plate (`feature-stairwell`), label "Feature · Low Ceilings, WF-007", the title "The stairwell sessions", an italic dek. Give this page an inset hairline so it reads against the black desk.

sections.title: Liner notes, part one
sections.summary: a drop-cap story about finding a closed Victorian baths in March, plus a plate (`feature-baths`).

sections.title: Liner notes, part two (a pink page)
sections.summary: the pull quote "A room is the fifth member of the quartet, and the only one who never misses a rehearsal." (Ife Okoro, cello) and spec rows: Room Stairwell B, Eastgate Baths; Reverb RT60 2.8 s; Mics 4, plus 1 on the roof; Takes 11, heating off.

sections.title: Roster · Marl Quartet
sections.summary: (string quartet, Leeds), 8. **Ines Haverford** (piano and voice, Glasgow), 9. **Dunmore & Ash** (guitar and harmonium, Whitby): a plate that fills the free space, name, mono meta line, one italic question and a short answer, and a link "On WF-00X →" to the catalogue.

sections.title: Catalogue, Side A (worn)
sections.summary: and 11. **Side B (stock):** WF-001 to WF-008, each with artist, italic title, year, edition and a status chip (Sold out / In stock / At the plant, the last one pink). Include Marl Quartet, *Low Ceilings* as WF-007 and Penny Lowe Trio, *Night Bus Lullabies* as WF-008 (at the plant). Page 10 ends with a wide plate band (`sleeve-stack`); page 11 with "WF-008 reaches subscribers first. Get the next issue →".

sections.title: The pressing plant (worn)
sections.summary: "Where Thursdays go", a plate (`press-room`), and colophon rows: 500 copies on 180 g black vinyl; 32 pages stitched by hand; half-speed mastering; "14 of the 32 pages" on screen.

sections.title: Get the next issue (stock)
sections.summary: "Issue 08 is at the plant." An email field and a radio fieldset ("How should it reach you?": Side A, the zine in the post; Side B, email only; the chosen one fills pink). Validate in the browser with these errors: "Enter a valid email" / "Pick Side A or Side B". On success show "You're on the list." with a line about how issue 08 will arrive. **Never send a network request.**

sections.title: Back cover (a pink page)
sections.summary: the motto "Slightly off-centre, on purpose.", the mark and wordmark, "Records & zines · Leeds · Est. 2019", a CSS barcode, and a "Back to the cover" link.
